mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that compresses equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in unemployment rate exceeding 0.2 percentage points indicates deteriorating labor market conditions that typically precede corporate earnings deterioration and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.2pp, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in housing starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signal a broad-based consumer demand slowdown that typically triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or interaction Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions, a monthly decline in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates manufacturing sector contraction that typically precedes economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO declines during late-cycle expansions, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals robust consumer demand that typically supports corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS increases, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in CPI inflation exceeding 0.5 percentage points indicates accelerating inflation that typically triggers hawkish monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL rises > 0.5pp, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) exceeding 100k and decreases in unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 0.1 percentage points indicate an overheating labor market that typically leads to wage inflation and subsequent monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS rises > 100k and UNRATE falls > 0.1pp, or interaction Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: During early-cycle expansions, a monthly decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals a weakening housing sector that typically precedes broader economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST declines during early-cycle expansions, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.
